lines: Home now shows you what to ride next, and opens both doors.
It greets you by the time of day. The Next ride card offers the race that opens your next map: top three on Old Town Criterium opens Neon Docklands, with your best there.
A new rider is welcomed and sent to Prairie Paceline. A level goal counts the levels still to climb.
The Race door counts your maps and stars. An open tile goes straight to Race Setup; a locked one shows how to open it.
The Classes door features 30 Minute HIIT Cardio, and Ride alone opens Class Start.
When a ride opens a map, Home says so once, in gold, and the card has already moved on.
From a phone to a laptop, Home lays itself out to fit.
What the tests prove: the right map for every rider, both doors, and a banner that shows once.
Telo Ride, from the Telo family, turns a smart bike at home into a game.
It pairs with the bike over Bluetooth, reads your power and sets resistance for every hill and interval.

lines.text: Two doors: Race, ride a map against your best-time ghost, bots or people; and Classes, ride along to a video, alone or with a group; fed by one progression of XP, rider levels, stars and map unlocks.
